approval_requirements: Review and separately authorize the correction commit; do not commit automatically.

After commit, regenerate and review the lock against that exact committed source and actual execution environment. This dirty-source proposal cannot become executable by changing authorization fields.
Explicitly approve execution and issue a separate approved lock with a real maintainer_review identifier.
Keep the original proposal/preflight unchanged; do not reuse old-schema execution locks.

construction.amplitudes: signal_photons * detected_signal_fractions[j] / sum(unit component counts[j]) on this grid and shifted generating IRF
construction.background: Added after convolution, counts per bin
construction.deterministic_target: Exact generating expectation; private deterministic objective path, never relabel as raw counts
construction.identity: Dxx:mean or Dxx:poisson-r; assumed IRF appended only to problem ID, never random seed
construction.normalization: Existing explicit trapezoidal unit-area IRF normalization; no endpoint zeroing
construction.pairing: Generate once per observation identity and reuse exact bytes across all assumptions and policies

sampled.provenance: explicit synthetic sampled fixture; not measured

output.report: Capture outside the checkpoint directory; unknown JSON evidence within it is rejected.

provenance.description: All fields under fingerprint are enforced; provenance/review notes outside it are descriptive. No numerical settings or generating conditions changed.

two_stage_contract.attempts: Immutable start receipts distinguish never-attempted tasks from missing results of prior attempts. Running/interrupted attempts block execution until termination is reconciled. Failed, timed-out and completed attempts are never automatically retried.
two_stage_contract.prepare: Fresh directory only; write durable preparation marker, all six hashed inputs, atomic aggregate input_inventory.json, then re-read and verify everything. No worker starts.
two_stage_contract.report: Verify provenance before cross-scoring; preserve original hashed result payloads and return derived analyses separately. Missing numerical outcomes remain in all-attempt denominators.
two_stage_contract.run: Verify execution fingerprint, aggregate inventory, all inputs, task associations, all existing attempts and receipts. Never generate or regenerate inputs.
two_stage_contract.workers: Exactly one durable worker start receipt per attempt; results bind approved lock, sealed inventory and exact input payload.
